segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hey, yeah, quick gut check on the Northstar renewal before I send it. They’re at 42 seats today, asking for 55, same support tier, go-live on the analytics add-on September 1.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Okay. Term is still twelve months or did they want coterm with the services agreement?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Coterm, so it runs August 15 to next August 14. Procurement asked for net 45 and a PO required on invoice. Nothing weird otherwise.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: I used $86 per user per month, then the add-on is $9,600 flat for the year. Comes out to $66,360 before tax.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: That should fit the discount band. Did you get deal desk approval already?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, but it took me most of yesterday. I had to put the same seat count, dates, billing contact, and PO language into the CRM, then the quote tool, then the billing tool, then the contract request, and deal desk kicked it back once because the start date didn’t match in one place.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Ugh, okay. As long as the final PDF matches what they saw on the call, we’re fine.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep. I’m going to send the proposal with the order form and a short note. If they sign by Friday, finance said first invoice can go out on August 20.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Perfect. Maybe mention the 55 seats includes the three admin licenses, because that confused them last time.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Good call. I’ll add one line on that and copy Ava in procurement.
